bibl.title: Police Procedures and Petitions in Roman Egypt: The Role of Village Officials.
bibl.seg: Roberto Mascellari, Police Procedures and Petitions in Roman Egypt: The Role of Village Officials.
Micaela Langellotti & Dominic Rathbone (edd.), Village Institutions in Egypt in the Roman to Early Arab Periods = Proceedings of the British Academy. 231 (Oxford, 2020) pp. 20-40.
bibl.note: On the involvement of village officials during the first three centuries of Roman rule in the early stages of investigation of alleged crimes and the part they might have played in determining the behaviour of the victims and the selection of a certain legal procedure, such as the submission of written complaints to higher office-holders.
